title: Prove Boolean rewrite steps in Lean by direct terms, not truth tables
summary: Boolean rewrite steps of the legacy proof object are now proved in Lean by direct, axiom-free proof terms that propagate truth values through the connectives and split on atoms only where needed, with the exponential truth table kept as a fallback. Rewrites over a dozen or more atoms, including z3test 3632 through the legacy core, are certified in under a second instead of failing on Lean's heartbeat limit.
